name: Pinewood
summary: Beltrami County tower dated 1934 in the county report, about 20 miles west of Bemidji; moved in 2004 to the Beltrami County Fairgrounds, where it stands and is open to climb during the fair.
design: four-legged steel structure with a metal observation room at the top, per a 1960 survey note
status_note: Moved in 2004 to the Beltrami County Fairgrounds near Bemidji, where it stands; no source describes the Pinewood site today

access.note: At the fairgrounds the tower is open to climb during the Beltrami County Fair, four climbers at a time; a 2016 article said it was open by appointment May 1 to October 1 and during fair hours

visit.trail_note: Climbing during the county fair, four people at a time; closed in rain, lightning or strong winds; 2022 fair schedule Wednesday to Saturday until 9 p.m., Sunday until 3 p.m.

events.note: Dated 1934 in the Beltrami County report table, owner shown as Mn MFS
Moved to the Beltrami County Fairgrounds near Bemidji with private donations, after Quam learned it was to be taken down for scrap
The lookout was moved to the Forestry Education Center.
